items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.description: Thrown flask: 1d4 fire damage each turn until doused.

items.name: Antitoxin
items.description: Advantage on saves against poison for 1 hour.

items.name: Cloak of Protection
items.description: +1 to AC and saving throws while attuned.

items.name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.description: Advantage on Stealth checks. Footsteps make no sound.

items.name: Ring of Free Action
items.description: Ignore difficult terrain. Magic cannot slow or paralyze you.

items.name: Dagger of Venom
items.description: A +1 dagger with a poisoned edge. Limited charges.

items.name: Chewed Bones
items.description: Gnawed clean. Goblins don't waste food.

items.name: Broken Goblin Idol
items.description: Crude clay figure with a cracked head.

monsters.name: Goblin
monsters.notes: CR 1/4 — use 2 goblins, MM p.166. Nimble escape, hides behind tents.

monsters.name: Hobgoblin Sentry
monsters.notes: CR 1/2 — use 1 hobgoblin. Holds the line and shouts for help.

monsters.name: Goblin Boss
monsters.notes: CR 1 — use 1 goblin boss. Stays back and orders the goblins around.
